capabilities: Render recipe notes as interactive cards with scalable ingredients and inline timers
Plan meals on a weekly planner stored as a Markdown note
Consolidate meal-plan ingredients into a grouped grocery list
Import recipes from URLs, Mealie exports, or schema.org Recipe JSON
Log cook history in frontmatter and share recipes via read-only links
extras: Directory listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta releases are available via BRAT (AdamArcane/obsidian-recipebox).
problem: Obsidian has no recipe-specific tooling, so recipes stay plain notes without scaling, timers, meal planning, or grocery-list consolidation.

relations.evidence: Import your whole collection at once from Mealie, or from any app that exports schema.org Recipe JSON.
History is stored as a structured array in frontmatter, making it queryable with Dataview or Obsidian Bases.

summary: Recipe manager that renders Markdown recipe notes as interactive cards, with meal planning, grocery lists, cook history, web import, and link sharing.
